titles.romaji: Pro Yakyuu wo 10-bai Tanoshiku Miru Houhou
titles.native: プロ野球を10倍楽しく見る方法

description:
Based on the two books of career reminiscences by real-life Hanshin Tigers baseball star Takenori Emoto.

Mix of live action and animation to tell humorous anecdotes from professional baseball (nine short tales in nine "innings").

(Source: AniDB)
